{"metadata":{"description":"High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session-log doctor, reusable DSH Web GUI","id":"gh:1333470417","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-lark-link","slug":"amlyczz/dsh-lark-link","topics":["bot","bridge","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","feishu","lark"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, car"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"d-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session-log doctor, reusable DSH Web GUI"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"🪶 dsh-lark-link"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness × 飞书/Lark 双向桥接 — 把你的 DSH 智能体装进飞书，扫码 30 秒上线，随时随地对话"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"# 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**DeepSeek Harness × 飞书/Lark 双向桥接插件** —— 把你的 DSH 智能体装进飞书：扫码 30 秒上线、消息零丢失、卡片化交互、每飞书会话独立 Agent。手机上随时给 "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"Agent 派任务、看结果、切模型切模式——不用守着终端。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 🌟 为什么选 dsh-lark-link"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **零门槛**：扫码即建飞书应用，不用手搓开放平台、不用配回调、不用公网服务器
- **零丢失**：出站 Outbox + 入站 WAL 双持久化，进程崩溃 / 插件热更 / dsh 重启，消息和"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"回答都补得回来
- **零学习成本**：所有切换类命令都是单选卡片，点一下即生效；DSH 原生命令（/goal /compact …）直接用
- **真 Agent**：不是聊天机器人——bash/文"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"件/子代理/工作流全套工具，飞书里跑完整 Harness
- **统一控制台**：DSH 设置面板与插件详情页无缝复用专属控制台，四维监控、动态调控、无任何侧栏挤占"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## ✨ 特性"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| 能力 | 说明 |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| 🎨 **官方品牌 Logo** | 原创设计的 Feather-Nexus 矢量微标（`assets/icon.svg` / `assets/logo.svg`），原生注入设置面板与包导出，极高视"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"觉辨识度 |
| 🎯 **一键认证** | `/lark setup` 扫码创建飞书应用（自动订阅消息事件 + 群聊全量 + 表情权限 + 用户基本信息），**30 秒上线**，无需手搓开放平台；也支"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"持 `DSH_LARK_APP_ID/SECRET` 手动通道 |
| 🧠 **多模式 Agent** | 标准 / PTC / 极简 / Cordis preset + 你在 GUI 自建的 pre"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"set，飞书发 `/mode` 出**单选卡片**即切（默认 PTC：一次执行多步工具调用，更快更省） |
| 🎛 **权限分级** | 只读 / 工作区写 / **Full access** 三种权"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"限，`/permission` 卡片即切；默认 Full access 全放行 |
| 🎨 **卡片化命令** | `/mode` `/permission` `/model` 全部是**单选按钮卡片"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"**——点一下即切换，不用记命令拼写；模型选择按供应商分组展示 |
| 💬 **意图确认转发** | 模型提问（`ask_user_question`）→ **飞书意图确认卡片**（选项按钮 + 下拉"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"多选 + 自定义输入），答完模型继续，飞书里完成完整交互闭环 |
| 😊 **表情回执** | 收到消息随机表情"已收到"；回复完成 / 命令完成打 **DONE ✅**（只使用飞书实测有效 emoj"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"i） |
| 💪 **出站零丢失** | 持久 Outbox（JSONL + at-least-once + 幂等键 + 分航道并行 + 失败离队不阻塞 + 周期清理），kill 重启自动续投；桥命令"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"回复同样走 Outbox |
| 📥 **入站请求补发** | Agent **处理到一半**插件/dsh 崩溃/重启，重启后自动重新触发这条用户消息（不再静默丢请求）——Inbound WAL 持久"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"化 + 原子快照压实 + 启动对账 + 次数上限/时间窗防空转；支持 `/lark replay` 手动触发与 `replay drop` 丢弃 |
| 🛡 **连接自愈** | probe 驱动受控"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"重连 + QuotaGovernor 配额熔断（窗口过期**自动解除、自动重连**）+ 断连补偿；环境代理自动规避 |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 🚀 快速开始"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**前置**：Node.js ≥ 24，已安装 DeepSeek Harness（`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`）。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**安装（官方 `dsh plugin` 机制，无侵入）**——包以官方 bundle 格式分发（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`）"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"，安装后自动并入 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 层："},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> **`--ignore-scripts`**：飞书 SDK 的传递依赖 protobufjs 带一个可忽略的 postinstall，pnpm 11 安全策略会拦截并返回非零退出码；加此参数跳过（"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"protobufjs 不执行 postinstall 完全可用）。若你的 pnpm 已全局放行，可不加。
>
> **`--profile web`**：指定安装到哪个 profile（web / t"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ui / headless）。`dsh plugin` 是 pnpm 的转发命令，用法为 `dsh plugin --profile <name> <pnpm 参数>`。想让飞书和 GUI 共用 we"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"b profile 就保持 `web`。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 每次发布后：更新到最新版"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 🌟 Why dsh-lark-link"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Zero setup friction**: QR-scan app creation — no Open Platform fiddling, no callback URL, no pub"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lic server
- **Zero message loss**: durable Outbox (outbound) + Inbound WAL — crashes, hot reloads, "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"and dsh restarts all recover
- **Zero learning curve**: every toggle is a single-select card; native"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" DSH commands (`/goal` `/compact` …) just work
- **A real agent**: full tool belt (bash / files / su"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"bagents / workflows) driven from Feishu"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Capability | Description |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| 🎯 **One-click auth** | `/lark setup` scans a QR to create the Feishu app (auto-subscribes message "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"events + group-all + reactions). 30-second onboarding; manual `DSH_LARK_APP_ID/SECRET` channel also "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"supported |
| 🧠 **Multi-mode Agent** | Standard / Code / Minimal / Cordis presets + your custom GUI "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"presets; `/mode` shows a **single-select card** — tap to switch (default Code: multi-step tools in o"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ne shot) |
| 🎛 **Permission tiers** | Read-only / workspace-write / **Full access**; `/permission` c"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ard switches instantly (Full access by default) |
| 🎨 **Card-based commands** | `/mode` `/permission"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"` `/model` are all **single-select button cards** — tap, no typing; models grouped by provider |
| 💬"},{"id":"p22s8","text":" **Intent confirmation** | Model questions (`ask_user_question`) land as **Feishu intent-confirmatio"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"n cards** (option buttons + multi-select dropdown + custom text); answer and the agent resumes |
| 😊"},{"id":"p22s10","text":" **Reaction receipts** | Random "got it" reaction on inbound; **DONE ✅** on completion (only Feishu-"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"validated emojis) |
| 💪 **Outbound zero-loss** | Persistent Outbox (JSONL + at-least-once + idempote"},{"id":"p22s12","text":"ncy + per-lane parallel + failure quarantine + periodic prune), resumes after kill/restart; bridge c"},{"id":"p22s13","text":"ommand replies ride the Outbox too |
| 🆕 **Inbound request replay** | If the agent dies / plugin rel"},{"id":"p22s14","text":"oads / dsh restarts MID-TURN, the interrupted user message is auto re-triggered on boot (no more sil"},{"id":"p22s15","text":"ently dropped requests) — durable Inbound WAL + boot reconciliation + attempt/time caps; `/status` s"},{"id":"p22s16","text":"hows the pending-replay count. **Opt out**: `/lark-config replay.auto=false` (or `DSH_LARK_AUTO_REPL"},{"id":"p22s17","text":"AY=0`), then trigger manually with `/lark replay`; expired/exhausted records are surfaced as failed "},{"id":"p22s18","text":"and droppable via `replay drop` |
| 🛡 **Self-healing connection** | Probe-driven controlled reconnec"},{"id":"p22s19","text":"t + QuotaGovernor circuit breaker (auto-unblocks and reconnects after the quota window) + missed-mes"},{"id":"p22s20","text":"sage compensation; auto-avoids proxy env |
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
